sources.title: RunningHubAI/rh-krea2-realism-slider-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The slider doesn't just add detail or remove it—it changes how Krea interprets the image, from anime eyes and painted textures all the way to skin pores and camera-like realism. Use it whenever the model's idea and your idea aren't quite having the same conversation. This repository provides rh-krea2-realism-slider-lora weight files.
